fusions.name: Dropped Anchor
fusions.desc: Hurls an anchor that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, leaving them [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses 4 shots at once, spread apart, each dealing 9 damage and knocking the target 2.5 tiles back.

fusions.name: Full Sail
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 8% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tarred Hull
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12%, and you have 10% water resistance.
